title: 《思维的版图》— 好书精读 Read 85
title_en: The Geography of Thought — Deep Reading Read 85

questions.question: 按尼斯贝特的框架，分析式思维与整体式思维最根本的区别在于？
options: 一方擅长严密的形式逻辑推理，另一方的抽象推理能力天生就比较弱
一方习惯用语言思考，另一方更习惯用图像和直觉思考
把因果安放在物体内部的属性上，还是安放在物体与周遭的关系里
一方偏好个人利益，另一方更愿意为集体利益牺牲自己
questions.explanation: 书中说两者不是聪明与笨的区别，而是「把因果安在哪里」：亚里士多德把下坠的原因放进石头的「重性」里，整体式则从相互作用解释。把差别读成逻辑能力高低，正是文章明确反对的误读。
questions.question_en: In Nisbett's framework, what is the most fundamental difference between analytic and holistic thinking?
options_en: One is good at formal logic, while the other is innately weaker at abstract reasoning
One tends to think in words, while the other leans on images and intuition
Whether causes are located in an object's own properties or in its relations with its surroundings
One favors individual interest, while the other is readier to sacrifice for the group
questions.explanation_en: The book says the difference is not smart versus dull but where causation is placed: Aristotle put the cause of falling inside the stone's "gravity," while holistic thinking explains behavior through interaction. Reading it as a gap in logical ability is the misreading the article explicitly rejects.

questions.question: 为什么整体式思维的人更容易出现后见之明偏误（「我早就知道」）？
options: 他们更相信命运早已注定，因此会把任何结局都看作必然发生的事
集体文化里承认自己没料到会丢面子，所以人们往往倾向于事后声称自己早有预见
手里的因果网太大，任何结局都能接回某几条线索，于是什么结果都不算意外
整体式思维更关注背景，对故事主角的细节记得较少，回忆更容易被改写
questions.explanation: 文章给的机制是解释力：因果网越大，越能把任何结局说通，也就越不容易被证伪、越不会惊讶。面子压力听起来合理，但不是书中给的解释。
questions.question_en: Why are holistic thinkers more prone to hindsight bias ("I knew it all along")?
options_en: They believe more strongly in fate, so they treat any outcome as something bound to happen
In collectivist cultures admitting you didn't foresee something costs face, so people claim foresight afterward
Their causal web is so large that any outcome can be traced back to some threads, so nothing seems surprising
Holistic attention goes to the background, so they recall the protagonist less well and memory is easily rewritten
questions.explanation_en: The article's mechanism is explanatory power: a bigger causal web can make sense of any ending, so it is harder to falsify and less likely to produce surprise. Face-saving sounds plausible, but it is not the book's explanation.

questions.question: 关于这本书的实证基础，「多实验室 2 号」这类大规模复现项目给出的提醒是？
options: 复现结果显示差异来自基因，因此不能再说它可以随环境改变
书中的东西方差异几乎全部无法复现，整套理论已被证伪而放弃
不少经典效应本身能复现，但「文化会调节它」这一层往往很弱或测不出来
复现证实了东西方是两个几乎不重叠的人群，组间差异远远大于各自的组内差异
questions.explanation: 文章说这些差异是分布的平移、组内差异远大于组间差异，而大规模复现发现文化调节效应常常很弱，所以该当「部分被支持的纲领」读。说成全盘被证伪，同样读过了头。
questions.question_en: What caution do large replication projects such as Many Labs 2 add to this book's evidence?
options_en: The replications showed the differences are genetic, so they can no longer be said to shift with environment
Nearly all of the book's East–West differences failed to replicate, and the theory has been abandoned
Many classic effects replicate, but the claim that culture moderates them is often weak or undetectable
They confirmed East and West are two barely overlapping populations, with between-group gaps exceeding within-group ones
questions.explanation_en: The article stresses these are shifts in distributions, with within-group variation far larger than between-group, and that large replications often find cultural moderation weak. So the book should be read as a partly supported program; calling it wholly refuted overshoots the other way.
